mission.head.title.value: Our mission is to humanise every day.

mission.head.body.value: Introduce and live the culture of humanism for the elderly. In Taourirt, ageing with dignity is not a privilege — it’s a right we defend, face by face, since 1998.

mission.vision.eyebrow.value: Humanity at the heart of our care

mission.vision.title.value: Humanism at the heart of our care

mission.vision.body1.value: Humanism is simply respect for dignity, solidarity and kindness. That is exactly our association’s DNA. Since 1998, volunteers, caregivers and donors take turns offering presence, care and comfort to isolated elders in Taourirt and surrounding douars.

mission.vision.body2.value: We intervene at home, in partnership with the local health centre, and run a warm welcoming place where intergenerational bonds are woven. Each visit, each meal, each smile counts.

mission.vision.card.body.value: A city where no elder feels forgotten, where each older person is surrounded, listened to and respected.

mission.promise.card.body.value: Intervene within 48h after a report, confidentially and unconditionally, with human follow-up.

mission.terrain.card.body.value: Listening, errands, light follow-up, shared meals — a human presence first, not just material aid.

mission.timeline.body.value: An association born from civic momentum, structured over the years without ever losing its soul: proximity.

mission.timeline.98.body.value: A few families in Taourirt gather to visit and support isolated elders.

mission.timeline.05.body.value: Opening of the administrative premises and launch of weekly solidarity meals.

mission.timeline.15.body.value: Partnership with the health centre: screenings and nursing follow-up for our beneficiaries.

mission.timeline.24.body.value: Over 14,400 meals and 340 home visits, thanks to 45 volunteers and donors.

mission.valeurs.body.value: Three simple words translated into daily, measurable, shared gestures.

mission.approche.body.value: One report is enough. Our method is simple, human and rigorous — designed with families.

mission.impact.body.value: Total transparency: each action documented, each dirham tracked and shared with donors.

mission.valeurs.1.body.value: Preserving each person’s autonomy, privacy and choices — down to the smallest daily details.

mission.valeurs.2.body.value: A responsive local mutual-aid network that leaves no one behind — in town and in the douars.

mission.valeurs.3.body.value: Listening without judging, reassuring, smiling — the presence that changes a day, sometimes a life.

mission.approche.1.body.value: Form or call. Acknowledged within 24h, in full confidentiality.

mission.approche.2.body.value: Volunteer pair on site, with the family and the health center if needed.

mission.approche.3.body.value: Aid plan, regular visits, meals, intergenerational bonds — support over time.

mission.impact.measure.1.value: Visit log signed by every beneficiary and volunteer.

mission.impact.measure.2.value: Monthly reports (photos, receipts) sent to regular donors.

mission.impact.measure.3.value: Partnership with the health center for medical follow-up.

mission.impact.gov.body.value: Non-profit association, accounts presented at the annual general assembly. Reports and galleries are published regularly for our donors.

mission.quote.text.value: “Thanks to the association, my father receives visits every week. We feel less alone.”

mission.trust.title.value: “Growing old surrounded means still belonging to the city.”

mission.trust.body.value: — Words of an 82-year-old beneficiary, supported since 2019.
